title: Palmetto Fellows Scholarship
provider: South Carolina Commission on Higher Education
amount: Up to $6,700 (freshman year) and up to $7,500 (sophomore-junior-senior years); Enhancement adds $2,500/year for eligible majors (total up to $10,000/year)
duration: Up to 4 years of undergraduate study
eligible: South Carolina high school seniors who are academically high-achieving and plan to attend an eligible college or university in South Carolina. Application is made during the senior year through the high school counselor. The award must be applied directly toward the cost of attendance and is paid in two instalments (fall and spring).
desc: The Palmetto Fellows Scholarship is a state-funded merit scholarship for high-achieving South Carolina students attending an eligible institution in South Carolina. Recipients may receive up to $6,700 in the freshman year and up to $7,500 for the sophomore, junior and senior years; the Palmetto Fellows Enhancement adds a further $2,500/year for students in certain majors, bringing the total award up to $10,000 a year. Source: Scholarships360 editorial guide (2026), which links to the official South Carolina Commission on Higher Education information. Verify current amounts, deadlines and eligibility on the official website before applying.

title: Florida Benacquisto Scholarship
amount: Award equal to the cost of attendance at an eligible Florida institution
eligible: Florida high school graduates who receive National Merit Scholar recognition. Requirements: earn a standard Florida high school diploma; be a National Merit Scholar; enroll in an eligible Florida postsecondary institution during the fall academic term following high school graduation; be a U.S. citizen or eligible non-citizen; enroll full-time in a baccalaureate degree programme.
desc: The Benacquisto Scholarship is a merit-based award for Florida high school graduates who are National Merit Scholars. Eligible students receive an award equal to the cost of attendance at an eligible Florida postsecondary institution. Source: Scholarships360 editorial guide (2026), which links to the official Florida Department of Education program information. Verify current details on the official website before applying.

title: CalKIDS College Savings Scholarship (California)
amount: $25 (children born 1 Jul 2022-30 Jun 2023), $100 (born on/after 1 Jul 2023) + $25 bonus when claimed; additional $500 for low-income or English-learner public school students, +$500 for foster youth, +$500 for homeless youth
duration: One-time seed deposit into a California 529 college savings account
eligible: Children born in California on or after July 1, 2022 receive an automatic college-savings scholarship (select older children may also qualify). Additional amounts apply for low-income or English-learner public school students, foster youth and homeless youth. Funds are held in a California 529 college savings account for future education costs.
desc: CalKIDS (California Kids Investment and Development Savings Program) automatically opens a college savings account for children born in California on or after July 1, 2022, with seed awards of $25-$100 (plus a $25 claim bonus) and additional $500 amounts for low-income/English-learner students, foster youth and homeless youth. Source: Scholarships360 editorial guide (2026), which links to the official CalKIDS program. Verify current details on the official website before applying.

title: NHSC Scholarship Program
provider: National Health Service Corps (U.S. Health Resources & Services Administration)
amount: Full tuition and fees + monthly living stipend + annual stipend for other educational costs
duration: Per year of study; requires a service commitment at an NHSC-approved site after graduation
eligible: U.S. citizens and U.S. nationals enrolling as full-time post-secondary students in an eligible primary health care program (e.g. medical, dental, nurse practitioner, physician assistant). Recipients must serve at an NHSC-approved site in a Health Professional Shortage Area (HPSA) after graduation. Highly competitive.
desc: The NHSC Scholarship pays students' entire tuition and fees and provides a monthly stipend for living expenses and an annual stipend for other educational costs. In return, recipients must serve at an NHSC-approved site in a Health Professional Shortage Area after graduation. Source: Scholarships360 editorial guide (2026), which links to the official NHSC program. Verify current details on the official website before applying.

title: NCAA Postgraduate Scholarship Program
amount: $10,000 (126 awards per year: 21 women + 21 men in each of the fall, winter and spring seasons)
eligible: Student-athletes in their final season of NCAA athletic eligibility (or who have completed it), nominated by their institution's Faculty Athletics Representative (FAR). The award can be used at colleges inside or outside the United States. Season deadlines: January 8 (fall), April 1 (winter), June 7 (spring).
desc: The NCAA Postgraduate Scholarship Program awards 126 student-athletes $10,000 each per year (21 women and 21 men in each of the fall, winter and spring seasons) toward postgraduate education after their athletic eligibility ends. Source: Scholarships360 editorial guide (2026), which links to official NCAA program information. Verify current details on the official website before applying.

title: Posse Foundation Scholarship
amount: Full-tuition scholarship from a partner college/university
eligible: High-achieving high school students nominated or recruited for leadership potential (Posse recruits students who demonstrate leadership and academic potential). The application process includes interviews and group assessments (Dynamic Assessment Process) rather than a standard application.
desc: The Posse Foundation awards full-tuition scholarships from partner colleges and universities to students with strong leadership and academic potential, supporting them through the entire undergraduate process with pre-college training. Selection uses interviews and group assessments. Source: Scholarships360 editorial guide (2026), which links to the official Posse Foundation. Verify current details on the official website before applying.

title: Skechers Foundation Scholarship Program
amount: $300,000 total across 60 high-achieving high school seniors
eligible: High school seniors with a minimum GPA of 3.0 planning to attend a two- or four-year accredited college/university, technical, or vocational education program. Four component programs: Financial Hardship (demonstrated need), Academic Excellence, Promising Leaders, and Athletic Performance (only for students playing a sport at collegiate level). Annual deadline: April 15 (2026 call: 15 April 2026, 11:59pm EST; winners announced 22 May 2026).
desc: The Skechers Foundation awards $300,000 in scholarships to 60 high-achieving high school seniors each year through four programs (Financial Hardship, Academic Excellence, Promising Leaders, Athletic Performance). Applicants need a minimum GPA of 3.0 and plans to attend a two- or four-year accredited college, technical or vocational program. Source: Scholarships360 editorial guide (2026). Verify current details on the official Skechers Foundation website before applying.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
amount: Full cost of study: tuition, living allowance, visa and health insurance
duration: Duration of the chosen Master's or PhD programme at Cambridge
eligible: Students from outside the UK pursuing a postgraduate (Master's or PhD) degree at the University of Cambridge. Approximately 80 awards are made each year. Applicants are considered automatically when they apply to Cambridge.
desc: The Gates Cambridge Scholarship enables students from outside the UK to study at the University of Cambridge free of cost, covering the full cost of tuition, an allowance for living expenses, visa and health insurance. Around 80 awards are made each year and applicants are considered automatically when they apply to Cambridge. Source: Scholarships360 editorial guide (2026), which links to the official Gates Cambridge Trust. Verify current details on the official website before applying.
